study.question: g2-r0017-sketch256 AUC=0.6203373142, Logloss=0.1958900564, train=429.6744s, wall=520.8848s, inference=18.1517s; g2-r0017-exact_replay AUC=0.6200683975, train=408.2252s, inference=19.1067s; g2-r0017-sketch64 AUC=0.6201641686, train=423.0677s, inference=17.8817s; g2-r0017-sketch256_alt AUC=0.6202825965, inference=18.0180s. Thus hashing reduced measured inference versus exact here but did not reduce measured training; more bins are not a monotone cost win. g2-r0016-log_local AUC=0.6202837665 versus g2-r0017-exact_replay=0.6200683975 warns against interpreting replay differences as mechanism evidence. g1-r0012-joint_identity AUC=0.6204259428, train=548.3580s, wall=642.9674s, inference=19.2176s. Earlier compact_summary=0.6191293980 and compact_matched=0.6195180296 did not fully retain incumbent utility; fine_context=0.6200897204 recovered part. Local/product=0.6200553701 exceeded factorized/product=0.6198326327 in round 14, and log_local=0.6202837665 exceeded log_factorized=0.6198141460 in round 16; leave recency localization fixed. Fine action-age refinement did not improve the local-product reference (fine_action_observed=0.6199866501 versus local_product=0.6200553701). All available trajectory statuses are success, but these are negative or inconclusive scientific branches, not execution failures. No complete committed scoped-memory hits were returned for identity or sketch/recency terms; do not invent records. Observed remaining uncertainty: whether marginal entropy and collision coordinates add distinct predictive value beyond support and each other. Candidate-supplied diagnostics report substantial neither-group support and tiny hashed-vs-exact residual differences, but are first-512 algebra checks, not population attribution or cost profiling. Can a support-plus-collision representation retain utility with less measured computation, and does Shannon entropy contribute conditionally on collision (or conversely)?
study.hypothesis: The fixed target-conditioned recency/count backbone may capture much utility, while repeat concentration sum(p^2) supplies most remaining marginal-diversity information. Shannon entropy could be dispensable conditional on support and collision. Collision-only omits logarithmic distribution reductions; support-only may be cheaper still if both diversity families are unnecessary. These are falsifiable implementation hypotheses, not established mechanisms or claims of original statistical estimators.

nearest_work.difference: Direct inherited model. Replace full hashed distribution readout by factorial entropy/collision family removal, preserving support. Full replay verifies the common implementation. This is a local sufficiency study; no architectural novelty claimed.
Frozen quality reference uses joint identities and embedded history components. Candidate inherits compact product-of-marginals branch; its comparisons cannot identify category-brand event binding.

DIN uses learned target-conditioned weighted event pooling and explicitly avoids softmax normalization to retain interest intensity. Local baseline_reference.py uses a field-adapted softmax, so it is not an exact DIN reproduction. Proposed summaries retain explicit counts and fixed target-match groups, with no learned event attention.

Only author README is available; it confirms category/brand/action histories lack item identity. No full-paper mechanism verification or DMR reproduction claim; concentration here is over coarse fields.

External pCVR systems describe transport, token/query mechanisms, compression or direct interactions. This proposal performs marginal-statistic removal in an existing shallow CTR summary. It adopts none of those systems and cannot validate their transfer. Broader priority search for entropy/collision recommenders is unverified; no novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: A preregistered entropy-present x collision-present factorial in the 28-coordinate residual input, retaining four support coordinates in every cell. Removed coordinates are zero and their arithmetic is skipped. Collision-only needs two fixed bucket tables and sum of squared bucket counts but no distribution logarithms. Support-only needs no bucket tables. Same allocated weights and RNG allocation order. New optional diagnostics use an independent quadratic hashed-identity oracle and a deterministic equal-collision/unequal-entropy witness only under host no_grad; neither enters training.
predictions: Collision-only will lose at most 0.00030 validation AUC against both the contemporaneous full_summary and frozen joint_identity references; this is a prospective practical retention margin, not a statistical equivalence conclusion from one seed.

Collision-only will reduce measured training or end-to-end inference time by at least 5% versus full_summary without increasing the other by more than 5%. If no cell does so, no extra efficiency gain is claimed even if feature removal retains AUC.

Conditional effects are delta_H_given_C=A11-A01 and delta_H_without_C=A10-A00, delta_C_given_H=A11-A10 and delta_C_without_H=A01-A00; report interaction A11-A10-A01+A00. H is entropy and C is collision. Expected small entropy conditional effect; support-only and entropy-only remain discriminating controls, not presumed losers.

Full replay and reduced outputs must match the independent dense oracle with max error <=2e-5; padding, reversal, masked-coordinate and empty-history diagnostics must be <=2e-5. All logits must be finite. Same-checkpoint replacement sensitivities describe model reliance only, not retrained causal effects.
falsifiers: Any reduced candidate loses more than 0.00030 AUC against either quality reference: reject its practical retention screen. A passing seed-42 result is provisional until paired repetitions and user-cluster uncertainty if available.

Lossless algebra/source checks fail, a removed family is still computed in forward, or any logit is nonfinite: treat as implementation failure, charge failed costs and repair before interpreting scores.
No >=5% measured cost gain, or >5% regression on the other cost axis: reject the proposed additional efficiency claim for that cell. Omitted operations alone do not establish a bottleneck.

Entropy-only matches or exceeds collision-only, or both families have meaningful conditional gains: weaken the concentration-sufficiency explanation and retain the full or better supported representation.

If support-only retains utility and lower cost, evidence supports dispensability of both families for this backbone rather than a special collision mechanism. AUC/Logloss disagreement (Logloss degradation >0.00020) blocks an unqualified quality claim.
alternative_explanations: Zeroed input columns lower effective head capacity even though allocated parameters, matrix dimensions and initialization draws are matched. This tests representation sufficiency, not a capacity-independent biological or causal mechanism.
Hash collisions distort original identity distributions. Conclusions concern this fixed 256-bucket map, not exact original entropy or event binding.
Product entropy is exactly the sum of marginal entropies; product collision is a nonlinear product. Removing either family also removes its inherited redundant/product coordinates.
Single-seed noise, checkpoint selection and measured system load can imitate small utility/cost differences; seed-42 replay is not an independent repetition.

Host checkpoint selection, optimization trajectory, and small mapping-dependent regularization may explain apparent differences. No test feedback, bootstrap samples or labels are exported to the coding jail.

Static user/ad snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; causal history prefixes do not establish production point-in-time validity. Histories cap at 128 events; no statement about longer history sufficiency.

Support coordinates duplicate match-group counts when there are no missing pairs; support-only retains a small extra nonlinear head on counts, so it is not a no-history/no-head control. No family-removal effect alone establishes event pairing or broad compressibility.
